items.title: Khaled ‘fills Hasan’s shoes’ with maiden county fifer
items.summary: Bangladesh fast bowler Khaled Ahmed claimed his maiden five-wicket haul in county cricket as he helped Kent recover after Lancashire’s strong start on Day 1 in Canterbury on Tuesday.

items.title: ‘Why investigate T20 World Cup absence now?’: Asif Nazrul questions
items.summary: Former sports adviser Dr Asif Nazrul was perplexed as to why Bangladesh’s decision not to travel to India for the 2026 T20 World Cup had to be investigated and the findings published so long after the incident.

items.title: 'The opportunity in 2016 made me the Ebadot you see today'
items.summary: A decade after that defining trial, Bangladesh pacer Ebadot Hossain stood on the stage at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur on Tuesday, looking back at the day that changed the trajectory of his career. He was there to help inaugurate the latest edition of the BCB and Robi Bowler Hunt, a nationwide talent search returning after an eight-year hiatus.

items.title: Probe blames Asif Nazrul, interim govt for Bangladesh’s World Cup miss
items.summary: The National Sports Council (NSC) formed the three-member probe committee on May 10 to investigate the reasons behind Bangladesh’s absence from the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8.

items.title: Hasan Mahmud withdrawn from Kent duty by BCB
items.summary: Fast bowler rested ahead of busy international winter with county vying for promotion

items.title: Mehidy four-for takes Amazon Warriors to eighth win; TKR finish last
items.summary: Trinbago Knight Riders, the defending champions, finished bottom of the table after sinking to their seventh defeat of the season

items.title: Shafali, Deepti power India into sixth T20 Asia Cup final
items.summary: Both teams were sub-par with their fielding, but India comfortably prevailed over Bangladesh in Dubai

items.title: Pakistan or Sri Lanka in the final? 'Doesn't matter,' says Deepti Sharma
items.summary: "I think that it will be a day here or a day there, it happens," Deepti Sharma says after India had another poor fielding day in the Women's T20 Asia Cup semi-final against Bangladesh
